name: Plannotator Inbox
description: Brings your Plannotator Inbox replies back into the Orca chat that asked. Works with the stock Plannotator Inbox; nothing is patched.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Plannotator Inbox. Press to open it.

settings.title: Deliver replies to Orca chats
settings.description: When off, replies wait in the Inbox and agents read them the next time they look.

settings.title: Notify when a reply needs you
settings.description: A desktop notification when Orca cannot confirm a reply was delivered.

settings.title: Plannotator data folder
settings.description: Leave empty to use Plannotator's own default (PLANNOTATOR_DATA_DIR, then ~/.plannotator).

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Leave empty to use the CLI inside this Orca. Set it only if delivery reports that the CLI was not found.
